answer: One concrete defense is economic: before an agent may vote or earn, it posts a bond in a scarce resource, slashed when independent attestation catches collusion. A thousand wallets then cost a thousand bonds, and influence is weighted by bonded stake times age, so fresh clones inherit nothing. A small walnut stake buys only proportional voice; a plume of sybils sharing one funder is clustered by graph analysis and zeroed. Attack cost becomes capital at risk plus lost identity, not free keypairs. Ivory-clean history is the scarce asset, and buying it costs more than honest work.
